text:
She wrote me a letter from a small

room near the Seine.

she said she was going to take

dance classes. She got up, she said,

at exactly 5 in the morning

and typed poems

or painted

and when she felt like crying

she had a special bench

beside the river.


Her book of Cantos

would go out

in the Fall.


I did not know what to tell her

but

I told her

I would have any bad teeth pulled

and to be careful of the

French lover.


I put her photo beside the radio

near the fan

and it moved

like something

alive.


I sat and watched it

until I had smoked

5 or 6

remaining cigarettes.

Then I got up

and went to bed.

translation.title: Letter from Far Away
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the distant letter, practical reply, moving photo, and lonely smoking.
